description: This file defines the Voicemail interface in Java for an Android project, representing a single voicemail entity with various getter methods and indicators of field presence.

classes.name: Voicemail
classes.description: Interface representing a single voicemail entry in the content provider, with methods to access its properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the voicemail; -1 if not set.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Indicates whether the ID field is set.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the phone number associated with the voicemail or null/empty if unknown or not set.

methods.name: hasNumber
methods.description: Indicates whether the number field is set.

methods.name: getTimestampMillis
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the voicemail was received in milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: hasTimestampMillis
methods.description: Indicates whether the timestamp field is set.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the voicemail in milliseconds; zero if not set.

methods.name: hasDuration
methods.description: Indicates whether the duration field is set.

methods.name: getSourcePackage
methods.description: Returns the package name of the app that added this voicemail, or null if not set.

methods.name: hasSourcePackage
methods.description: Indicates whether the source package field is set.

methods.name: getSourceData
methods.description: Returns a source-specific identifier for the voicemail, e.g., server UID, or null if not set.

methods.name: hasSourceData
methods.description: Indicates whether the source data field is set.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the Uri for this voicemail, used for playback or reference, or null if unknown.

methods.name: hasUri
methods.description: Indicates whether the Uri field is set.

methods.name: isRead
methods.description: Returns whether the voicemail has been marked as read.

methods.name: hasRead
methods.description: Indicates whether the read status has been explicitly set.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Indicates whether there is content stored at the Uri.
